capturedAtStatement: NULL BY CONSTRUCTION. This record is a declaration committed BEFORE any measurement or prediction exists; a timestamp would be the only field a replay could not reproduce.
status: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY v3 PREDICTION WAS COMPUTED. Changing it after a prediction is a declared NO-GO.
claim: The complete rule by which the far tier emits rooftop mass, fixed in advance so that no later measurement can be met by quietly changing what is emitted.

emissionRule.statement: Every V3Prism the committed plan emits, with the plan's own kind, ring, baseZMm, topZMm and materialId. No exclusions, no substitutions, no additions.
emissionRule.noExclusions: Water-tank legs are INCLUDED. T010's shading derivation excluded them, for the different and correct reason that their footprints lie inside the tank's and would double-count roof occupancy. Geometry is not occupancy: a leg occludes, so it is emitted.
emissionRule.noSubstitutions: material:metal is not remapped to material:roof. Through v3TextureClassFor it carries spandrel-panel, so a tank's flat colour is v3tCalibratedFactor(metalHex, spandrelMean) x boxMean(spandrel) and NOT the roof colour. roof-equipment carries material:roof.

grammarAdjudication.whatHappened: The frozen plan's emission rule named two different things as one: 'what the -c2 wave used' and 'V3_SHIPPED_GRAMMAR_OPTIONS, containment/clamp both false'. They are mutually exclusive, and the constant's NAME is the trap — V3_SHIPPED_GRAMMAR_OPTIONS is not what shipped.
grammarAdjudication.verifiedBy: Running the profile scripts/far-tier-bake-cli.mjs actually constructs, which is gated by the requirement that regeneration reproduce the committed -c2 checksums or the bake refuses to run.
grammarAdjudication.independentConfirmation: T002's frame check measured the source bound at 40.17 m. The shipped envelope reproduces 40,172 mm EXACTLY; the alternative gives 41,976 mm, which does not match the assets the far tier must agree with.
grammarAdjudication.adjudication: Grammar (A), MASS_GENERATION_ADMISSION_ENVELOPE. The governing clause was 'pin to whatever the -c2 wave used'; the parenthetical was an inherited error.
grammarAdjudication.consequenceForTheRecord: The far tier emits under the SHIPPED admission envelope and therefore agrees with the assets lod_0 and lod_1 ship: zero orphan legs, cluster clamp active, maximum prism top 40,172 mm. Any statement that the far tier ships orphan legs at 26-30% prevalence or unclamped clusters would be false, and is not made. The 26-30% figure is historical PRE-FIX context from ADR 0049 and nothing more.

rooftopDeltaComposition.wrongInPriorRecords: T002's sampling record and T010's derivation describe the 3.59 m delta as 'rooftop groups and parapets'.
rooftopDeltaComposition.correct: It is 100% water-tank cluster. round(2400 x 0.665) + round(3000 x 0.665) = 1596 + 1995 = 3591 mm, being the leg height plus the tank height at the plan's own scale permille.
rooftopDeltaComposition.theGrammarEmitsNoParapets: The only prism kinds the grammar produces are roof-equipment, water-tank and water-tank-leg. There is no parapet in the model at all.

clusterIsInvented.statement: The rooftop cluster is GRAMMAR-INVENTED (ADR 0049), not sourced. No source record says any of these buildings has a water tank.
clusterIsInvented.consequenceForTheFarTier: The far tier ships it ONLY on the ground that lod_0 and lod_1 already ship it, so the tiers agree with each other. It is never shipped as a fact about a real building.
clusterIsInvented.uncertaintyStringMustChange: The far tier's uncertainty string currently says rooftop groups are 'ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION'. Once v3 emits them that sentence is false and must be rewritten to declare an invented, tier-coherent appearance rather than an observation.

whatThisRuleForbids: Dropping a prism kind because it is small, awkward to pack, or unhelpful to a prediction.
Remapping a prism's material to one that happens to render closer to a target.
Adding geometry the plan does not emit, including any parapet, in order to reach a bar.
Changing the grammar envelope after a prediction has been computed.
notClaimedHere: Nothing has been emitted, measured or predicted at the time this record is committed.
This rule says what will be emitted. It says nothing about whether emitting it improves any pose.
